question:
**Direction : **In the following, part of the sentences (marked as A, B, C, D) has an error. Locate the correct alternative.

Mathematics (A) / is his (B) / most toughest subject. (C) / No error (D)
solution:
The correct answer is 'C' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In part C of the given sentence, the phrase 'most toughest' is incorrect.
 
• The word 'toughest' is already a superlative form of the adjective 'tough'.
 
• Using 'most' with a superlative adjective is redundant and grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be 'toughest' without the word 'most'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Mathematics is his toughest subject*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option A: 'Mathematics' is a correct subject name and does not have an error.
 
• Option B: 'is his' is correctly used to indicate possession and no error is present.
 
• Option D: 'No error' is incorrect because there is an error in part C.
